verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal offers online filing and IP-rights services, and government e-service platforms can plausibly provide test or sandbox environments for programmatic integrations, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only procedural descriptions of patents, trademarks and designs. It never mentions an API, a test environment, or any way to try filings without affecting real records. The llms.txt probe returning 404 shows no agent-oriented developer documentation exists.
